product_wide_rationale: Product identity is a Product-wide planning boundary. No child Domain may assign work found for another Product to the serving Product's backlog, and foreign-session routing must preserve the other Product's recorded authority.
summary: Requires foreign-session work to route by the other Product's recorded mode, use a path-scoped todo.md commit for local-only Products, refuse without a Product record, and create no serving-Product Concord work item.
title: Work for another Product leaves Concord
